plain_language: On Tideline's non-persistent virtual desktops, MetaDefender Endpoint shows as unregistered and loses its settings after each logoff. The log shows a certificate failure caused by the customer's SSL inspection proxy, and the profile tool restores settings late. Both are third-party products for the customer's teams and vendors. Elena will confirm the Endpoint side from the full log.

issues.text: On non-persistent virtual desktops, MetaDefender Endpoint users show as unregistered each morning and the pushed settings are gone after logoff and logon.

in_call.text: Customer read the Endpoint log from a desktop that shows as unregistered.
Agent explained that the virtual desktop platform, the profile tool and the inspection proxy are third-party products outside OPSWAT's scope.

findings.text: The Endpoint log says registration failed because the certificate chain is not trusted; the issuer is the customer's SSL inspection proxy, not the management server.
Desktops are reset to a base image at every logoff and a separate profile tool restores the user profile from a file share at logon.
The profile tool attaches the profile a few seconds after the Endpoint service starts, so the settings file is missing at start.
The SSL inspection proxy appears to apply to every desktop in the pool; the customer is not fully sure.
Endpoint appears to be behaving as designed, pending review of the full log.

next_actions.action: Send the full Endpoint log from one affected desktop.
Pass the findings to the virtual desktop team and the network team.
Confirm the Endpoint side against the full log.
Send the documented guidance for non-persistent desktops.

open_questions.text: Whether anything on the Endpoint side contributes beyond the third-party behaviour; to be confirmed from the full log.

third_party_components.name: Customer's Citrix-style VDI platform
third_party_components.role: Delivers non-persistent virtual desktops that reset to a base image at every logoff.

third_party_components.name: User profile management tool
third_party_components.role: Restores the user profile from a file share at logon, a few seconds after the Endpoint service has started.

third_party_components.name: SSL inspection proxy
third_party_components.role: Sits between the desktops and the management server and presents its own certificate, so Endpoint registration fails on trust.
